presets.name: Portable Bark 1972
presets.description: Cube rubber tips and a close pickup: the warm bark. Passive tone. Editable approximation, not a copy of any particular instrument.

presets.name: Tine Bass 1960
presets.description: A short bass keyboard, E1 to B3, in a felt-tip voicing. Play it in the bottom octaves. Editable approximation, not a copy of any particular instrument.

presets.name: Felt Tips 1966
presets.description: The softest hammer tips and the darkest attack of the set. Passive tone. Editable approximation, not a copy of any particular instrument.

presets.name: Console Bark 1973
presets.description: The same mechanism through an active console preamp and its stereo vibrato. Editable approximation, not a copy of any particular instrument.

presets.name: Portable Bell 1977
presets.description: Graduated tips and a later tine, where the bark begins to turn towards bell. Editable approximation, not a copy of any particular instrument.

presets.name: Console Bell 1978
presets.description: The later mechanism through the second console preamp, brighter in its EQ. Editable approximation, not a copy of any particular instrument.

presets.name: Portable Chime 1980
presets.description: The most bell and the least deep bark of the set. Passive tone. Editable approximation, not a copy of any particular instrument.

presets.name: Wide Dynamics 1984
presets.description: A later action, reaching further between a soft touch and a hard one. Editable approximation, not a copy of any particular instrument.
